newsitem.title: USA: Group denies charges in IBS Financial suit.
newsitem.headline: Group denies charges in IBS Financial suit.

text.p: A group including Seidman and Associates L.L.C. said Monday it has denied allegations raised in a lawsuit filed against it by IBS Financial Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it also filed a counterclaim seeking to compel IBS to produce shareholder lists and to invalidate the reduction of the IBS board to six members.

The reduction, it alleged, constitutes "an improper action" taken to avoid the group gaining a position of influence or control in IBS. The group, which holds a 5.52 percent stake in IBS, is seeking a seat on the company's board.
